settings: logic; all placement and travel settings
reference_behavior: One combined world graph models inventories, events, age, MM time and shuffled routes.
native_behavior: A combined pool consults two independent native reachability engines and exchanges portal/song arrivals until convergence.
practical_implication: All-reachable and beatable guarantees apply to the native model. Passing them cannot establish OoTMM equivalence.
recommended_next_step: Create a translated-setting differential oracle before claiming that a website setting or route is equivalent.
evidence_boundary: Confirmed source difference; gameplay equivalence not tested by this audit

reference_behavior: At-will Song of Time age change requires the Temple of Time TIME_TRAVEL event. Most OoT areas permit it unless explicitly disabled.
native_behavior: Local age change uses four equipment modes without that Temple event, and generation permits it only in 76 named regions.
practical_implication: Native logic is more permissive before the pedestal event and less permissive in many dungeons. This affects generation, not just tracker display.
recommended_next_step: Translate the intended age-change contract, then port supported region edges and associated equipment predicates together.
evidence_boundary: Confirmed source difference; gameplay equivalence not tested by this audit

reference_behavior: The normal Door of Time opens from its song event. Pedestal time travel normally requires owning Master Sword; the separate switch can remove that requirement.
native_behavior: Native Closed requires the song, three stones and Ocarina of Time. Song Only is a separate value. Pedestal age propagation has no explicit Master Sword inventory prerequisite.
practical_implication: The same closed-door label and ownership of Master Sword do not imply the same route requirements.
recommended_next_step: Make the website Closed equivalent to native Song Only if website parity is desired; decide pedestal ownership policy separately.
evidence_boundary: Confirmed source difference; gameplay equivalence not tested by this audit

reference_behavior: Spirit routes explicitly use time-travel alternatives for child rooms, mixed-age attacks and collection.
native_behavior: Spirit is outside the song-age-change allowlist. SpiritShared retains its native age/key-access analysis. Forest and Training Ground substitutions cover selected rooms only.
practical_implication: A Slingshot cannot globally replace Bow; some valid age-changing routes are missing, while Bow-only targets must remain Bow-only.
recommended_next_step: Compare and port room-level age changes and actual target interactions; do not replace every adult projectile requirement with a generic OR.
evidence_boundary: Confirmed source difference; gameplay equivalence not tested by this audit

reference_behavior: Adult descent and child transformation for Well entry is a separately enabled trick.

practical_implication: This implements the user-requested shortcut, but it is not the website default technique contract.
recommended_next_step: Keep the chosen policy explicit; add a separate trick permission only if website-compatible technique selection becomes a goal.
evidence_boundary: Confirmed source difference; gameplay equivalence not tested by this audit
